senses.gloss: ṭhambhana or ˚nā (= Skt. stambhana; from this root Pali records only forms with th-, as thambhanā, and so Pkt. except Gr. and Lex. ṭh-, see Sheth), restraint, constraint, (hostile) immobilization: avamānanā, tathā vimāna ca ṭhambhanāś ca (… mama nāmadheyu smaramāṇa labhanti mokṣam) Gv 〔213.25〕 (vs).
